name: Can architectural millwork be integrated into existing structures or is it only for new construction?

mainEntity.name: Can architectural millwork be integrated into existing structures or is it only for new construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Architectural millwork can be effectively integrated into both existing structures and new construction projects. In existing buildings, it often involves custom solutions to match or enhance current architectural styles, addressing unique space constraints or design challenges. For new construction, millwork is designed as an integral part of the overall building plan. The key difference lies in the design phase; integrating into existing structures may require more precise measurements and a focus on blending new elements with established aesthetics. Both scenarios allow for highly customized and functional results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, architectural millwork can be integrated into existing structures by customizing designs to match current styles, as well as being a core part of new construction.
